subject.title: fix(doctor): flag missing plugin install paths

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` remove any persisted plugin install record whose primary `installPath` or `sourcePath` is missing, rather than limiting cleanup to enabled/configured plugins or reinstall-capable official plugins?
rationale: The patch is source-correct and now has terminal proof, but deleting persisted install records is an upgrade-sensitive doctor behavior that should be an explicit maintainer choice.

options.title: Land the registry cleanup
options.body: Accept the operator-run doctor behavior: missing primary install-record paths are stale ledger entries and should be removed before registry refresh.

options.title: Narrow cleanup scope first
options.body: Require the PR to limit deletion to configured/enabled or otherwise recoverable records if maintainers want stronger preservation of dormant install ledger entries.

options.title: Pause for a broader recovery design
options.body: Keep the PR open while deciding whether missing records should trigger reinstall/recovery rather than ledger removal.

recommendation.title: Land the registry cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept the operator-run doctor behavior: missing primary install-record paths are stale ledger entries and should be removed before registry refresh.
